claim: continuity demo runs the bundled Maple Street Books recovery path in a fresh temporary workspace.
where: home first action, demo page, README
sandbox: Fresh caller directory; run both demo entry points; assert unique OS-temp workspaces, three bundled files, no caller-directory writes.

claim: The first-screen sample action opens an isolated browser preview without reading or changing the saved real license.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep '@claim:sample-demo-page'
sandbox: Fresh browser page with a sentinel real license; enter /demo/ in one click, exercise and reset it, then assert no external requests or storage changes.

claim: A pack run writes an encrypted .cpack, readable restore manifest, and matching JSON receipt.
sandbox: CLI demo output; assert three artifacts, CPACK format, no plaintext sample records in ciphertext, readable manifest, and receipt SHA-256.

claim: Packs use authenticated XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption with an Argon2id passphrase-derived key.
where: home feature ledger, README privacy section
sandbox: CLI demo pack; verify succeeds with the sample passphrase and exits 4 with authentication failure for a wrong passphrase; Rust unit coverage fixes the named primitives.

claim: The CLI has no telemetry or upload path and writes packs only to an explicit filesystem target.
sandbox: Run the full demo with libc network socket creation blocked and observed; assert success and no socket attempt; run pack without --target and assert exit 2 with no files.

claim: A scheduled check exits non-zero with an actionable error when its target is unavailable, stale, corrupt, or unreadable.
sandbox: Run CI check against a unique absent target and assert exit 3 plus target-unavailable stderr; Rust regressions cover stale, corrupt, and wrong-passphrase paths.

claim: Restore rechecks the pack and reproduces every bundled sample file byte for byte with a restore report.
sandbox: CLI demo result; compare all three restored files with repository fixtures and inspect RESTORE-REPORT.txt.

claim: Pack, check, verify, restore, stable exit behavior, and JSON output require no paid license.
where: home feature ledger and Plus section, terms, README
sandbox: Environment without a license; run the complete demo in CI JSON mode and assert one valid JSON result with verified true.

claim: The CLI accepts passphrases from a file, environment variable, hidden prompt, or supported OS keychain.
where: home feature ledger, privacy page, README
sandbox: Verify the sample through a mode-0600 passphrase file and environment variable; query keychain status without storing a secret; CLI tests cover noninteractive prompt refusal.

claim: The guide and direct sample preview work offline after the first visit.
where: home facts and offline status; /demo/ offline status
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep '@claim:offline-guide'
sandbox: Own fresh browser context; enter /demo/ directly with a sentinel real license, await a controlling service worker, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample H1, offline strip, and unchanged real license.

claim: The normal home and sample-demo flows send no analytics, record data, third-party fonts, or third-party scripts.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep '@claim:browser-privacy'
sandbox: Fresh browser page; record every request while loading home and exercising demo; assert the only origin is the product origin.

claim: Protected Plus downloads admit at most 20 requests per client in a fixed 60-second window across deployed workers.
where: protected download API response policy and privacy page
sandbox: 60 concurrent POST requests plus a six-worker Azure Blob atomic-append simulation; exactly 20 are admitted and 40 return 429 with Retry-After.

claim: Plus field-kit files are returned only after a live active-license check and are absent from the public build.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep '@claim:licensed-download'
sandbox: Recorded valid license fixture; assert bearer authorization on the protected API and a browser download; API and build tests cover invalid tokens and absent public files.

claim: Continuity Plus costs $39 once and uses the registered Sociobot checkout.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep '@claim:plus-price-and-checkout'
sandbox: Recorded production-registry fixture; assert exact price copy and navigation only to the matching Sociobot checkout URL.
